title: Security Engineer
description:
About SME Bank

SME Bank is a dynamic and innovative digital bank, committed to providing secure and seamless financial services to our customers. As a regulated financial institution under LT and EU guidelines, we prioritize trust, transparency, and cutting-edge technology to deliver a modern banking experience.




We are looking for a skilled Security Engineer to join our team. The successful candidate will play a key role in daily security operations, technical reviews, and supporting our information security management system (ISMS). You will work closely with the CISO and broader IT/security teams to safeguard SME Bank’s systems, data, and customers.




What You Will Do

Operational Security Tasks (weekly basis)

 * Review and analyze SOC alerts.
 * Manage and investigate MS Defender alerts.
 * Triage and respond to security inbox inquiries.
 * Review and follow-up on DLP alerts.




Non-Operational & CISO-Assigned Tasks

 * Support phishing simulations (quarterly) and ongoing campaign maintenance.
 * Conduct and document vulnerability management activities, including scanning results and penetration test findings in JIRA.
 * Assign and review security awareness trainings and track employee results.




Other Security Responsibilities

 * Maintain security testing within the development process.
 * Conduct technical 3rd-party security reviews.
 * Support access control reviews and related maintenance.
 * Act as part of the internal ISMS audit team.
 * Contribute to other ISMS-linked initiatives as assigned.




What You Need to Succeed

 * Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
 * 2–4 years of hands-on experience in information security operations or a related role.
 * Strong familiarity with security tools and processes (e.g., SIEM, EDR, DLP, vulnerability scanning).
 * Working knowledge of security standards and methodologies (e.g., ISO27001, NIST).
 * Ability to investigate and resolve security alerts with a structured approach.
 * Good communication skills and the ability to work across teams.
 * Proficiency in English (Lithuanian a strong advantage).




What We Offer:

 * Paid vacation as per the company's time-off policy, with an extra day off on your birthday, additional days based on tenure, self-learning time for your development, and a paid trust day annually for personal use.
 * Private health insurance (activated post-trial period).
 * Workplace flexibility.
 * A culture of recognition, with prizes, rewards, paid trips, gifts, and individual/team awards.
 * Branded birthday gifts, financial support for weddings and newborns, along with extra time off. We provide compassionate time off and financial support during challenging times.
 * Company events and activities biannually.




Salary

2800 – 4000 €/month gross, depending on experience and qualifications.

title: Security Engineer (Incident Response), Group Security
description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Vinted is the leading second-hand fashion marketplace in Europe and a go-to destination for all kinds of second-hand items. With a mission to make second-hand the first choice worldwide, Vinted enables people to sell and buy second-hand clothes and lifestyle items from each other, helping give those items a second or even third life.

Vinted Go launched in 2022, with a focus on developing products and solutions for more seamless shipping and delivery across Europe. Vinted Go has connected more than 60 carriers and more than 500,000 PUDO points across Europe to support the delivery of millions of parcels per year.

The Vinted Group, composed of Vinted Marketplace, Vinted Go, and Vinted Pay is headquartered in Vilnius, with workplaces in Germany, Lithuania, France, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands and over 2,000 employees. Its backers include Accel, EQT Growth, Insight Partners, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sprints, and TPG.

Information about the position

As a Security Engineer focusing on technical security engineering challenges, you will be part of the Group Security function, which supports the whole organisation. As a Cyber Defense team, we adopt or develop technological solutions to protect the security of Vinted members and employees and to secure the organisation against external and internal threats. To achieve this, we provide consultations, incident response, threat intelligence, security awareness and security-enhancing technologies and services to the organisation.

In this position, you’ll:


 * Lead and participate in the lifecycle of security incident response, from detection and analysis to containment, eradication, and recovery.
 * Develop and implement detection engineering strategies, creating and fine-tuning alerts to identify malicious activity across environment.
 * Design, build, and maintain security automation and tooling that automate incident response workflows, enrich alerts, and integrate the security stack.
 * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure a coordinated and effective response to security events.
 * Track, research, and experiment with the latest tactics, techniques and procedures for attacking and defending on-prem and cloud environments.
 * Mentor and guide other engineers on the team, sharing your expertise and helping to level up collective capabilities.
 * Create, track and iterate on metrics that showcase actionable insights to leadership across Vinted.
   
   

About you:


 * Hands-on experience in engineering roles, with a strong focus on infrastructure security.
 * Proficient in software development (e.g., Python, Go) and have experience building security-focused tools.
 * Practical experience building and scaling security programs, including SOCs, IR teams, and on-call rotations.
 * Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to quickly triage and investigate security incidents
 * Can communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders and work well in cross-functional teams.
 * Excellent at communicating in spoken and written English.
   
   

Work perks


 * 
    * The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
    * 25 working days of holiday
    * Newest MacBook models
    * Free access to an office gym
    * Mental and emotional health support through the Mindletic app
    * Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
    * Private health insurance
    * On-site canteen serving delicious homemade food at friendly prices
    * Frequent team-building events
    * A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
    * The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workation
    * A dog-friendly office
      

Working at Vinted

Individual Learning Budget

We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.

Hybrid Work

We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.

Equal Opportunity

The Vinted Group is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and life experiences. At Vinted, all applicants are treated fairly without regard to their race, age, religion or belief, sex, national origin, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

The salary range for this position is €4,975 - € 8,842 gross per month.

description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Vinted is the leading second-hand fashion marketplace in Europe and a go-to destination for all kinds of second-hand items. With a mission to make second-hand the first choice worldwide, Vinted enables people to sell and buy second-hand clothes and lifestyle items from each other, helping give those items a second or even third life.

Vinted Go launched in 2022, with a focus on developing products and solutions for more seamless shipping and delivery across Europe. Vinted Go has connected more than 60 carriers and more than 500,000 PUDO points across Europe to support the delivery of millions of parcels per year.

The Vinted Group, composed of Vinted Marketplace, Vinted Go, and Vinted Pay is headquartered in Vilnius, with workplaces in Germany, Lithuania, France, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands and over 2,000 employees. Its backers include Accel, EQT Growth, Insight Partners, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sprints, and TPG.

Information about the position

We are expanding the Marketplace Security domain and looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer to join an established team dedicated to enabling member security in Vinted.

As a backend software engineer, you will play a key role in driving technical initiatives, building new services, developing and maintaining features. Your main aim will be preparing the product for technical challenges ahead, ensuring Vinted members feel safe on the platform, and contributing to the Vinted vision of making second-hand the first choice. By joining Vinted you will become part of an active community of engineers who are exceptional at delivering the highest grade solutions and are keen on sharing knowledge.

Here are some of the technologies we use:


 * Programming languages: Go, Ruby
 * Datastores: MySQL with Vitess, Redis
 * Observability: Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, ELK stack
 * Streaming platform: Kafka
 * CI/CD: Kubernetes, ArgoCD, Jenkins
 * Auth: Okta, OAuth, Open Policy Agent
   
   

In this position, you’ll


 * Work in a cross-functional team, lead and contribute to team and domain-level initiatives, and shape the features to improve security for Vinted members.
 * Transform large monoliths into smaller, component-based services, thereby promoting greater team autonomy.
 * Work on bot account prevention and mitigation.
 * Monitor and ensure the reliability of your code.
 * Provide mentorship and support to engineers to foster their professional development
 * See your code affect 80+ million users almost instantly.
   
   

About You


 * You have hands-on work experience in development or operations at scale. Bonus points for experience in the cybersecurity domain.
 * You are driven by curiosity to explore and master new technologies and concepts.
 * You are committed to writing clean, maintainable code with a focus on accuracy and quality.
 * You have a strong inclination to collaborate with team members, share knowledge and foster a positive, cooperative environment.
 * You are willing to take the lead in addressing issues and driving improvements, even without explicit direction.
 * You are a great communicator able to get your point across in spoken and written English in diverse contexts.
